verdict.rationale: CoreWeave provides a full REST API (Bearer-token gated, confirmed live via probe) for cluster/resource management, a Terraform provider for IaC, and kubeconfig/kubectl access, all of which support headless CI/automation workflows. missing for 10: no dedicated CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or first-party automation SDKs beyond generated API clients, and no independent hands-on report confirming a full CI pipeline running against CoreWeave.
